articles.summary: BEVERLY, Mass., April 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Axcelis Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: ACLS), a leading supplier of enabling ion implantation solutions for the semiconductor industry will release financial results for the first quarter of 2026 after market close on Thursday, May 7, 2026.
articles.title: Axcelis Announces Timing and Availability of First Quarter 2026 Results and Conference Call
